inclusions: 7 nights accommodation in 4★ hotels on twin sharing.
Return airport transfers in Manila, Boracay and Cebu.
Airport/ferry transfers between Caticlan Airport and Boracay hotel.
Manila City Tour including Intramuros and Rizal Park.
Boracay Island Hopping Tour with snorkelling.
All sightseeing transfers on private/shared basis as mentioned.
Entrance fees for sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary.
Applicable local taxes and service charges

days.title: Day 1 | Arrival in Manila | Transfer & Evening at Leisure
activities: Arrival at Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Manila; meet and greet with our local tour representative.
Private transfer to your hotel and complete hassle-free check-in formalities.
Evening at leisure to relax after your flight or take a self-guided walk around Makati or Bonifacio Global City (BGC).
Explore upscale shopping, dining, and rooftop lounges in the city center.
Overnight stay in Manila.

days.title: Day 2 | Historic Manila City Tour & Bay Area
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Guided historic city tour: visit the walled Spanish city of Intramuros and Fort Santiago.
Visit San Agustin Church, a UNESCO World Heritage site and the oldest stone church in the Philippines.
Stroll through Rizal Park (Luneta), honoring national hero Dr. Jose Rizal.
Scenic drive along Roxas Boulevard overlooking the famous sunset vistas of Manila Bay.
Free time for shopping at SM Mall of Asia or Greenbelt complex.
Overnight stay in Manila.

days.title: Day 3 | Flight to Caticlan & Transfer to Boracay Island
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Transfer to Manila Airport for your domestic flight to Caticlan (Boracay).
Seamless land and speedboat transfer from Caticlan jetty to Boracay Island.
Check in at your beachfront resort and relax.
Stroll along Boracay's world-famous White Beach, known for its talcum-powder white sand.
Witness the mesmerizing sunset from the shore or aboard a traditional Paraw sailboat.
Overnight stay in Boracay.

days.title: Day 4 | Boracay Island Hopping & Snorkelling Adventure
activities: Breakfast at the resort.
Board a traditional motorized outrigger banca for an exciting island-hopping excursion.
Snorkel amongst vibrant coral reefs and exotic tropical fish at Coral Garden and Crocodile Island.
Visit Puka Shell Beach, famed for its coarse natural shells and serene turquoise surf.
Explore Crystal Cove Island or enjoy cliff jumping at Magic Island.
Relish a delicious barbecue seafood picnic lunch on the island.
Return to White Beach; evening free to enjoy live acoustic music and fire dancing by the sea.
Overnight stay in Boracay.

days.title: Day 5 | Boracay Leisure & Watersports Day
activities: Breakfast at the resort.
Full day at leisure to unwind under swaying palm trees or enjoy optional watersports.
Options include parasailing, paddleboarding, helmet diving, or scuba diving.
Explore D'Mall for local handmade souvenirs, beachwear, and refreshing mango smoothies.
Indulge in an authentic Filipino Hilot beachside massage.
Overnight stay in Boracay.

days.title: Day 6 | Flight from Boracay to Cebu
activities: Breakfast at resort and check-out.
Speedboat and transfer to Caticlan Airport for your domestic flight to Cebu.
Arrive at Mactan-Cebu International Airport; meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check in and relax.
Evening at leisure to sample Cebu's world-famous crispy Lechon and vibrant street markets.
Overnight stay in Cebu.

days.title: Day 7 | Cebu Heritage Tour & Mactan Exploration
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Visit Magellan's Cross, the historic Christian symbol planted by Portuguese explorer Ferdinand Magellan in 1521.
Explore the Basilica Minore del Santo Niño, the oldest Roman Catholic church in the country.
Tour Fort San Pedro, a military defense structure dating back to Spanish colonial rule.
Visit the Heritage of Cebu Monument and the Yap-Sandiego Ancestral House.
Cross over to Mactan Island to visit the Lapu-Lapu Shrine and local guitar crafting workshops.
Overnight stay in Cebu.

days.title: Day 8 | Cebu Departure
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Free time for last-minute souvenir shopping (famed Cebu dried mangoes and otap biscuits).
Transfer to Mactan-Cebu International Airport for your departure flight home.
Tour concludes with wonderful island memories of the Philippines.
